summary: Tested Resend certificate/report delivery integration, event completion workflow, RBAC, idempotency, reports regression, frontend Events desktop/mobile layout, and frontend production build.

critical.issue: Certificate delivery persists email_status=failed (expected sent) because Resend rejects recipient in test mode.
Smart Bulk Studio records keep email_status=failed with no provider acceptance despite valid flow.
Event report delivery finalizes as report_delivery.status=failed instead of sent because report emails are rejected by Resend.

minor.issue: Backend logs show express-rate-limit X-Forwarded-For trust proxy validation warnings (ERR_ERL_UNEXPECTED_X_FORWARDED_FOR).

action_items: Fix Resend sandbox recipient configuration mismatch so development deliveries are redirected to the exact verified inbox value expected by Resend.
Retest certificate + bulk + event report delivery after recipient config fix; verify email_status=sent and email_id population across all flows.
Optionally set Express trust proxy to avoid rate-limit proxy warnings in this ingress environment.
critical_code_review_comments: Resend idempotency keys are correctly present in code for certificate and event report sends (certificate/{cert_id}/delivery-v1, event-report/{event_id}/{admin_id}/delivery-v1).
Retry endpoint behavior is correct: only failed report deliveries can be queued (verified 202 for failed, 409 for non-failed).
RBAC for completion is enforced via events.create permission + admin/super_admin guard; editor/viewer were blocked with 403 as expected.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_RESEND_* events/certificates/bulk jobs and temporary editor/viewer users; cleanup executed for created users/events and test certificates.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Main blocker is real Resend provider rejection. Backend log shows 403 validation error: allowed testing recipient is anurag.singh.ls011@gmail.com, but current config uses a different value; this causes certificate and event report emails to fail and report_delivery.status to remain failed. Frontend Events page passed desktop/mobile overflow and long-title overlap checks, and data-testid uniqueness check on Events screen found no duplicates.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: run certificate bulk generate with participant email and complete an event containing certificates. Observed persisted email_status=failed and report_delivery.status=failed. Backend logs show Resend 403 validation_error explicitly stating only testing emails to anurag.singh.ls011@gmail.com are allowed. Current test recipient config does not match that exact verified address, so Resend rejects every send. Mitigation: correct sandbox recipient configuration to the exact verified inbox, then rerun resend integration tests for certificate and event reports.
